description:
Electric TV is a jointly funded online video platform by NECA and the IBEW where we produce short video features on the work of local NECA contractors and IBEW craftsmen and women. At ETV, we're looking to showcase stories that include NECA & IBEW working together to create the best electrical teams in the nation. 

The videos featured on the ElectricTV YouTube channel demonstrate the value of using a team that delivers quality products at fair prices and offers commitment, a high standard of craftsmanship—no matter the type or size of job. 

The training arm of Powering America is the electrical training ALLIANCE, which has assisted more than 350,000 apprentices achieve journeyman status through local affiliate programs. Electrical apprenticeships combine college-level learning—and credits—with on-the-job training and provides a chance to earn money while training.
